spans.s:
Oghavatī
(‘that which flows fast’)
------------------------------------------
The river सरस्वती of the Vedic fame is said to be seven in number. They are: Suprabhā, Kāñcanākṣī, Viśālā, Manoramā, सरस्वती, ओघवती and Sureṇu.
These may be the seven names of the same river, of which ओघवती is also one.
The पुराणस् and the epics sometimes describe that सरस्वती, the divine river, manifested itself in seven places at different times due to being invited by prayerful ṛṣis or sages. ओघवती was one of them that appeared in कुरुक्षेत्र due to वसिष्ठ’s prayer. It was on the bank of this river that the grandsire भीष्म lay on his bed of arrows and gave the great discourse contained in the Śāntiparva of the Mahābhārata (vide Śalyaparva 38.4).
